analysis.reasonEn: Current price $699.33 approaches the lower Bollinger Band ($709.28). RSI at 32.0 indicates oversold territory. MACD histogram continues to worsen at -6.5197. ADX at 27.0 shows a clear trend, but -DI (35.4) significantly outweighs +DI (13.3), signaling downward pressure. Five consecutive days of decline (-7.53% included) warrant a wait-and-see approach until buying pressure is confirmed.
